SELECT 'booking' AS kind, json_object('booking_id',b.booking_id,'request_id',b.request_id,'flight',b.flight_id,'passenger',b.passenger_id,'amount',b.amount_cents,'status',b.status,'client_reference',b.client_reference,'charge_id',c.charge_id,'key',c.idempotency_key,'charge_amount',c.amount_cents,'charge_state',c.state,'created_step',c.created_step) AS data FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN charges c ON c.booking_id=b.booking_id WHERE b.status<>'confirmed' UNION ALL SELECT 'event',json_object('event_id',event_id,'booking_id',booking_id,'payload',payload,'status',status,'attempts',attempts) FROM outbox WHERE status<>'delivered' UNION ALL SELECT 'cancel',json_object('event_id',event_id,'request_id',request_id,'step',step) FROM customer_events UNION ALL SELECT 'flight',json_object('id',flight_id,'capacity',capacity,'price',price_cents,'version',version) FROM flights UNION ALL SELECT 'fare_hold',json_object('id',hold_id,'flight',flight_id,'price',price_cents,'until',until_step) FROM fare_holds UNION ALL SELECT 'cache',json_object('key',key,'value',value) FROM cache UNION ALL SELECT 'config',json_object('service',service,'value',value) FROM service_config

SELECT 'pending' kind,json_object('id',b.booking_id,'request',b.request_id,'flight',b.flight_id,'passenger',b.passenger_id,'amount',b.amount_cents,'client',b.client_reference,'charge',c.charge_id,'key',c.idempotency_key,'state',c.state,'cancel',(SELECT group_concat(event_id) FROM customer_events e WHERE e.request_id=b.request_id),'related',(SELECT group_concat(x.booking_id||':'||x.status) FROM bookings x WHERE x.client_reference=b.client_reference AND x.booking_id<>b.booking_id)) data FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN charges c ON c.booking_id=b.booking_id WHERE b.status='pending' UNION ALL SELECT 'outbox',json_object('id',o.event_id,'booking',o.booking_id,'payload',o.payload,'attempts',o.attempts,'b_status',b.status,'b_flight',b.flight_id,'b_passenger',b.passenger_id,'checkin',ci.booking_id) FROM outbox o LEFT JOIN bookings b ON b.booking_id=o.booking_id LEFT JOIN checkins ci ON ci.booking_id=b.booking_id WHERE o.status='pending' AND o.event_id<'evt_00000400' UNION ALL SELECT 'config',json_object('service',service,'value',value) FROM service_config
